summary: Line-by-line forensic audit of all repository datasets, scripts, HTML boards, and coordination logs against first-hand official governing-body sources fetched on 2026-10-22.

findings.issue: 12 of 13 ATP 250 matches in /slate/ are fabricated pairings across Almaty (9410), Brussels (7485), and Lyon (496) (e.g., Cobolli and Nakashima placed in Almaty despite playing in Lyon; Musetti and Machac placed in Brussels despite playing in Lyon and Almaty; Landaluce vs Rublev in Lyon after Wawrinka eliminated Landaluce in R32 and Rublev is in Almaty), accompanied by wrong ATP rankings (Khachanov #16 instead of #25, Cobolli #20 instead of #6, Nakashima #37 instead of #17) and 6 invalid high-confidence predictions.
findings.resolution_in_center: Originated all 15 true Oct 22-23 ATP matches directly from official Almaty (9410), Brussels (7485), and Lyon (496) daily schedules and Oct 19 PIF ATP Singles Rankings.

findings.issue: /hub/ misattributed Lyon ATP 250 matches Cobolli vs Wawrinka (atp-902116) to Swiss Indoors Basel (328) and Moutet vs Paul (atp-902133, including high-confidence prediction prose) to Erste Bank Open Vienna (337), and misattributed WTA Osaka/Ningbo ties Gibson vs Krueger and Eala vs Shnaider to WTA Guangzhou Open (all three start Oct 26 with empty daily schedules on Oct 22).
findings.resolution_in_center: Mapped every ATP match to its verified tournament (Almaty 9410, Brussels 7485, Lyon 496) and every WTA match to Ningbo (2092) or Osaka (405).

findings.issue: 8 of 9 NAB AFLW Round 11 fixtures in /slate/ are scrambled/non-existent pairings (only North Melbourne vs Adelaide matches official match 8979), invalidating 4 high-confidence AFLW picks.
findings.resolution_in_center: Originated all 9 official NAB AFLW Round 11 fixtures (matches 8970, 8972, 8973, 8974, 8975, 8976, 8977, 8978, 8979) from the official 10-round 2026 AFLW ladder.

findings.issue: /slate/ falsely asserted Stephen Bunting withdrew from the Machineseeker European Championship and substituted Ritchie Edhouse (#33 on PDC Order of Merit, outside the 32-player cut) vs Danny Noppert, attaching a high-confidence pick to a non-existent pairing.
findings.resolution_in_center: Restored and originated the official Dortmund Round 1 tie (5) Danny Noppert vs (28) Stephen Bunting alongside all 15 other verified European Championship R1 ties.

findings.issue: /slate/ assigned Slessor vs Walden's match-centre UUID (619c8075-153c-41f4-96a8-de15606cbdd8) to Gilbert vs Cheung (true UUID 1e3806cf-eec4-42c7-b4fc-ed493bc6e236) and omitted 4 Last 16 players from wst_players, while /verified/, /board/, and /hub/ left 6 of 8 Northern Ireland Open Last 16 ties unlined despite server-rendered world rankings and 2026/27 break stats on wst.tv/players/{uuid}.
findings.resolution_in_center: Verified all 16 player UUID profiles on wst.tv and originated all 8 Northern Ireland Open Last 16 ties with exact match-centre URLs.

findings.issue: /hub/ inverted two SuperLega Round 2 pairings into Itas Trentino vs Rana Verona (played in Round 1 on Oct 18) and Vero Volley Monza vs Cisterna Volley, falsely accusing OLBG of swapping opponents.
findings.resolution_in_center: Originated all 6 official SuperLega Giornata 2 pairings (including Itas Trentino vs Cisterna Volley 39526 and Vero Volley Monza vs Rana Verona 39529).

findings.issue: 10 fabricated OLBG numeric sport IDs in /slate/ (e.g., Golf=9, Ice Hockey=15, Rugby Union=18, Handball=24, Esports=31, Gaelic Football=33) and 4 swapped IDs in /verified/ and /board/ (Volleyball=19, Aussie Rules=21, Esports=28, Greyhounds=4) contradict OLBG's sitemap.
findings.resolution_in_center: Enforced exact OLBG sitemap IDs across all 17 eligible categories (3,4,5,7,8,9,10,12,13,14,15,20,21,22,23,25,28) in sports.json, matches.json, and unit tests.

findings.issue: /verified/, /board/, and /hub/ listed the stale Bank of Utah Championship instead of the live Oct 22-25 Butterfield Bermuda Championship (R2026528), and VF-17 falsely claimed no Formula 1 Grand Prix occurs Oct 22-25 despite the 2026 United States Grand Prix at COTA running Oct 23-25.
findings.resolution_in_center: Listed Butterfield Bermuda Championship (R2026528) in Golf and originated 5 COTA United States GP driver H2Hs from 18-round 2026 WDC standings in Motor Racing.

findings.issue: /slate/ relied on community wiki liquipedia.net for LoL Worlds, priced Cricket ODIs from hardcoded ICC ratings (118/108/101) that render blank in icc-cricket.com server HTML, and priced synthetic Greyhound match bets from single semi-final clockings without trap draws.
findings.resolution_in_center: Replaced Liquipedia with official Riot GPR (lolesports.com) for LoL Worlds and left Cricket and Greyhounds lines strictly null (unverified_input) with explicit flags.

findings.issue: /verified/ and /board/ emitted non-standard quarter-point rugby/basketball handicaps (-5.75, -3.25, -5.25, -1.75) tuned to cluster at -238/-244/-250, and /board/ issued two high-confidence picks on the same NHL game (CAR @ EDM).
findings.resolution_in_center: Restricted all spreads/totals to authentic half-unit sportsbook increments (0.5) and enforced unique match_id across all featured predictions.

findings.issue: Root data/matches.json has 47/47 null source_url and olbg_url across only 4 sports; data/forward/ covers only 4 sports and omits Saturday URC R4 ties; data/survey/ queried 2025-26 SHL group 18263 (including relegated Leksands IF instead of promoted IF Björklöven in 2026-27 group 20961); and PR #77 overwrote 42c8f6be's COORDINATION.md entry.
findings.resolution_in_center: Restored 42c8f6be in COORDINATION.md (4b4d7f7), used 2026-27 SHL group 20961, included all 8 URC R4 ties, and attached verified https:// source_url and olbg_url to 100% of rows.
